## Version and environment

Game version/commit, Godot version, OS, graphics renderer. Do not include account
names, personal directory paths, or full unredacted logs.

## Reproduction

Steps, expected behavior, actual behavior.

## Evidence

Attach game-only screenshots or a short clip. Note any staged test conditions.
